stations.title: Dorrit
stations.say: Take each typed line apart, right.

stations.title: The form
stations.text: Stray spaces, gaps, an o in a ticket.

stations.title: The tickets
stations.text: Clean fields, and a word when one is wrong.

captions: Dorrit's form saves each ticket as one typed line, and she wants every line taken apart.
Today the lines go in as typed: stray spaces, missing fields, a letter in a ticket.
You trim fields, split lines at the separator, read numbers strictly, build clean lines.
A line with a letter in its ticket number is noticed and refused, not guessed at.
Dorrit's typed lines come out as clean fields now, and a wrong one is caught at once.
